title: "Where Rust May Not Be the Best Fit"
---

# Where Rust May Not Be the Best Fit
Rust may introduce unnecessary friction for:
- Disposable one-off scripts where Python or Bash finishes the job in minutes.
- Rapidly churning early-stage UI prototypes where types and domain models change hourly.
- Systems where memory footprint and latency do not matter and teams already possess deep expertise in managed languages.
